description: Compute the local price return and ECB FX contribution on open lots entered by the user, grouped by position and totalled across the portfolio. The foreign currency is USD for EUR-based portfolios and EUR for USD-based portfolios. Enter transaction dates and prices in the stated instrument currency. For paired lot amounts, use quantity 1. Optional interest rates and tenor give a forward hedge cost estimate, with no forecast or investment advice. Never reads saved portfolios or stores entries. Search-only clients can prefix the same arguments as compact JSON with fx: (up to 400 characters).

hedge.description: Optional forward hedge estimate from annual rates for the declared tenor, starting at valuation spot.

eur_rate_pct.description: EUR annual rate in percent, e.g. 2 for 2%.

tenor_days.description: Actual tenor in calendar days, using a 365-day year.

usd_rate_pct.description: USD annual rate in percent, e.g. 4 for 4%.

instrument_currency.description: Actual currency of all quoted prices, opposite the resident currency.

lots.description: One row per open purchase (real or hypothetical). Use the same label to group lots.

entry_date.description: Purchase or hypothetical entry date, YYYY-MM-DD.

entry_price.description: Entry price per unit in the instrument currency.

quantity.description: Units held, or 1 for paired lot amounts.

valuation_price.description: Valuation price per unit in the same currency.

resident_currency.description: EUR for a euro-area resident or USD for a US resident.

valuation_date.description: Date of the valuation prices, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: eur_usd_fx_calculator
title: MFM EUR/USD FX effect calculator
